drop_summary: QQQ hit a record on 2026-10-06 (762.86 intraday, 759.66 close) and closed at 709.80 on 2026-10-16, which is 6.96% below the intraday high and 6.56% below the closing high. That is a pullback, not a bear market: the fund is still up 15.54% YTD and 27.75% above its March low. Most of the drop came in the week of Oct 12-16 (-5.52%). It was led by chip stocks (AMD -18.6%, MU -16.0%, NVDA -10.5% from Oct 6 to Oct 16) as doubts grew about AI-capex payback and debt funding, China's CXMT made memory-competition news, and hot CPI/PPI data lifted odds of a December Fed hike with the 10-year yield near 5.1-5.3%.

drivers.driver: AI chip selloff: semis led the decline
drivers.detail: From the Oct 6 high to the Oct 16 close, AMD fell 18.58%, MU 15.95%, AVGO 12.52% and NVDA 10.50%, while AAPL rose 2.95% and MSFT was flat (Robinhood daily closes, computed in QQQ_calc.py). NVDA, MU and AMD alone account for roughly 2.5 of QQQ's 6.6-point drop by back-of-envelope weighting. On Oct 14 a chip index fell 4.3%, about 12% over six sessions, on worries about rates, valuations and AI infrastructure costs.
drivers.source_title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as CPI Data Fuel Fed Hike Bets: Markets Wrap (Bloomberg via Swissinfo)

drivers.driver: Doubts about AI capex payback and debt-funded spending (Broadcom CEO remarks; CoreWeave credit stress)
drivers.detail: On Oct 12 Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said many AI investors don't understand what they own and compared the mood to a casino. On Oct 14 CoreWeave bonds traded at yields near 15% (distressed levels), the stock fell about 16%, and Oracle, Nebius and Dell sold off with it. Per LSEG, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle have issued more than $228B of bonds this year. The Oct 16 AP wrap said investors doubt big tech can keep borrowing to fund AI as yields rise.
drivers.source_title: CoreWeave bonds trade like distressed debt as AI spending outpaces balance sheets (investingLive)

drivers.driver: China memory competition (CXMT 4F2 DRAM) hit memory names
drivers.detail: Over the Oct 10-11 weekend CXMT said it had made key progress on a denser 4F2 DRAM design and aims to ship server DDR5 on it by end-2026. Micron fell about 3.9% on Oct 12 and kept sliding. SK Hynix, Samsung and Kioxia fell sharply in Asia on Oct 13. MU is QQQ's #4 holding at a 4.32% weight.
drivers.source_title: Micron Falls 5% as China's CXMT Targets Server Memory; SanDisk Drops 4% (24/7 Wall St.)

drivers.driver: Hot September CPI and PPI raised December Fed-hike odds
drivers.detail: September CPI (out Oct 14) came in at 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% expected, with core at 2.6% vs 2.5%. QQQ fell 1.97% that day, its worst session since July per Bloomberg. PPI (out Oct 15) jumped 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y, the largest annual rise since Dec 2022. Per the AP, December hike odds rose to 74.3% from 50.2% a month earlier. This follows the Fed's 25bp hike on Sept 16 to 3.75-4.00%, its first since 2023.
drivers.source_title: US September CPI 3.7% vs 3.6% expected (investingLive); Wholesale inflation jumped by most in four years (AP via Spectrum News)

drivers.driver: High long-term yields and oil from the US-Iran war
drivers.detail: The 10-year Treasury yield topped 5.30% earlier in October (highest since 2002) and was 5.09% on Oct 16. Brent rose 3.7% to $109.86 on Oct 16 and about 4% on Oct 8, after remarks implying the Iran conflict would last past the midterms. That lifted hike odds and coincided with a defensive rotation into energy and staples while tech (XLK) fell 2.09% on Oct 8.
drivers.source_title: US markets weighed down by extended sell-off in the tech sector (AP via AJC)

drivers.driver: Broad Oct 16 tech selloff to cap the week
drivers.detail: On Oct 16 QQQ fell 2.50% (Robinhood daily data). Per the AP, the Nasdaq composite lost 2.1% and posted its worst week since June. AMD fell 6%, Intel 5.8%, Micron 5.6%, Broadcom 4.5%, Meta 3.7% and Alphabet 2.5%. Only 7 of 75 S&P tech stocks rose that day.
drivers.source_title: US markets weighed down by extended sell-off in the tech sector (AP via AJC)

bull_case.point: AI demand signals from the supply chain are still strong
bull_case.evidence: ASML (Oct 14) said customers are raising equipment demand forecasts, some want to order for 2029-2030, and planned supply for 2027-2028 won't fully meet demand. TSMC (Oct 15) reported Q3 revenue of $46.72B (+41.2% y/y), a 66.4% gross margin, and Q4 guidance of $52.3-54.3B.
bull_case.source_title: ASML Q3 2026 press release (SEC 6-K); TSMC Q3 2026 results (SEC 6-K)

bull_case.point: Earnings estimates are still rising, led by tech
bull_case.evidence: Zacks (Oct 12) expects S&P 500 Q3 earnings up 24.3% y/y with Tech up 43.3%, and says estimate revisions have been positive and broad-based for almost a year, with 2027 estimates also rising.
bull_case.source_title: Estimates keep rising as Q3 earnings season takes center stage (Zacks via FXStreet)

bull_case.point: The drawdown is modest and the longer trend is intact
bull_case.evidence: QQQ is 6.96% below its intraday high, still up 15.54% YTD and 18.30% over one year, and 27.75% above its 2026-03-30 low (Robinhood data, QQQ_calc.py). Non-chip mega caps held up: AAPL rose 2.95% and MSFT was flat from Oct 6 to Oct 16.

bull_case.point: Near-term catalysts are close: mega-cap earnings in late October
bull_case.evidence: Tesla reports Oct 21; Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft Oct 28; Amazon Oct 29; Apple Nov 2; Nvidia around Nov 18. Brooke Thackray says strong Mag 7 results could restart the rally.
bull_case.source_title: Technology earnings are the make or break event for Q3 earnings (BNN Bloomberg, Brooke Thackray)

bear_case.point: Rates moving the wrong way for long-duration growth stocks
bear_case.evidence: The Fed hiked 25bp on Sept 16 to 3.75-4.00%, and most officials see another hike likely by year-end. Hot CPI and PPI pushed December hike odds to 74.3% (AP). The 10-year yield topped 5.30% in October, the highest since 2002.
bear_case.source_title: Fed Raises Rates for 1st Time Since 2023 (Trading Economics); AP market wrap Oct 16

bear_case.point: Rich valuation leaves little room for disappointment
bear_case.evidence: Robinhood fundamentals show QQQ at a P/E of 34.15 and P/B of 9.22. StockAnalysis shows a trailing P/E of 29.05 and forward P/E of 21.57 (the methods differ). Thackray warns Q3 tech results below the high bar could be a serious problem, and that earnings growth should slow toward Q2 2027 as base effects reverse.
bear_case.source_title: Robinhood get_equity_fundamentals; StockAnalysis.com QQQ; BNN Bloomberg (Thackray)

bear_case.point: Heavy concentration in a few AI-linked names
bear_case.evidence: The top 10 holdings make up 46.94% of the fund (StockAnalysis, 2026-10-16). NVDA, MU and AMD alone are 16.22%, and those three explain roughly 2.5 of the 6.6-point drop since the high (QQQ_calc.py).

bear_case.point: AI build-out increasingly funded by debt, with credit stress showing at the edges
bear_case.evidence: Per LSEG, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle had issued more than $228B in bonds this year as of Oct 13, more than double their 2025 total. CoreWeave debt traded near 15% yields on Oct 14. JPMorgan sees hyperscaler capex near $800B this year and above $1T/yr by 2027.
bear_case.source_title: CoreWeave bonds trade like distressed debt as AI spending outpaces balance sheets (investingLive)

bear_case.point: New competitive threat in memory from China
bear_case.evidence: Counterpoint data cited by BabyPips shows CXMT reached 10% of global DRAM revenue in Q2 2026, up from 4% a year earlier, and it is targeting high-margin server DDR5. Micron is now QQQ's #4 holding (4.32%).
bear_case.source_title: Chip stocks October 2026: Broadcom casino comment, CXMT DRAM (BabyPips)

data_gaps: Alpha Vantage was unavailable all session. TIME_SERIES_DAILY with outputsize=full returned a per-second rate limit, then 'premium feature'. outputsize=compact, GLOBAL_QUOTE and ETF_PROFILE all hit the 25-requests/day limit on the shared key (last attempt about 20:22-20:32 UTC). The primary daily series is therefore Robinhood get_equity_historicals (split-adjusted, regular session), not Alpha Vantage.

Because the primary series and the main cross-check are both Robinhood, the only independent price checks are web pages (StockAnalysis.com and finanzen.net, both 709.80 on 10-16). StockAnalysis also independently confirms the 52-week high and low.
QQQ_daily.csv was transcribed from the Robinhood tool output. It was checked against a separate Robinhood weekly call (0 high/low mismatches over 52 weeks) and for OHLC consistency (0 violations).

The Invesco holdings page failed to load, so the top holdings come from StockAnalysis.com (third party) as of 2026-10-16, cross-referenced to the SEC N-CSRS as of 2026-03-31. AVGO's current weight is not in the source's top-10 list.
The holding contribution figures (pp) are rough estimates that back out starting weights from end weights and ignore intra-period rebalancing.
The Robinhood quote's 'close' field still showed 2026-10-15 (728.00) at retrieval, so the official 10-16 settled close comes from the daily bar plus web sources, not that field.
P/E is not consistent across sources: Robinhood 34.15 vs StockAnalysis 29.05 (trailing) and 21.57 (forward). Methods differ and neither is the issuer's figure.
Returns are price-only and exclude dividends. No AV NEWS_SENTIMENT data, because the rate limit blocked it.
The Oct 7 META decline (-2.4%) and the Oct 13 index moves have no single clearly cited cause beyond the general AI/chip sentiment covered above.
